package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for large_csv_or_json_export_without_bufio: Export data written in loops without visible buffering in handlers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func scenario321Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	db := queryDatabase()
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Write([]byte("["))
	first := true
	for _, row := range db {
		chunk, _ := json.Marshal(row)
		if !first {
			w.Write([]byte(","))
		}
		first = false
		w.Write(chunk)
	}
	w.Write([]byte("]"))
}

type exportRow struct {
	ID   int    `json:"id"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func queryDatabase() []exportRow {
	return []exportRow{{1, "alpha"}, {2, "beta"}, {3, "gamma"}}
}
